usedFor: Todoist holds your tasks, and Workflowy gets an outline item from “New Task Created in Project” through “Create Node”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Task Created in Project” in Todoist, then “Create Node” in Workflowy
bestTemplate.why: Tasks you capture in Todoist also appear in your Workflowy outline, with a title and note.

watchOut: “New Task Created in Project” is polling, so the node appears after the next scheduled check.
